source.note: No real product. A generic Japandi visual proxy made for the demo catalogue; it copies no retailer's design and carries no brand.
source.generation: Higgsfield multi_image_to_3d from a four-view AI turnaround sheet generated with the Codex image_gen tool (codex-image.sh); should_texture=true, enable_pbr=true, should_remesh=true, topology=triangle, target_polycount=30000, symmetry_mode=auto, rigging and animation off.
source.postProcessing: @gltf-transform/cli resize --width 1024 --height 1024, then scripts/fit_glb.py per-axis fit (centres the footprint, puts the base at y=0).
source.priceProvenance: invented: a plausible demo figure, not a real or quoted price

knownLimitations: No real product. Generic Japandi visual proxy generated from an AI turnaround sheet; the catalogue price is invented, not sourced.

Requested 40 x 40 x 160 cm. The generated lamp is more slender than that (raw height/width 5.0 against the requested 4.0), so scripts/fit_glb.py hit its 10% anisotropy cap and applied the closest fit inside it: 36.1 x 36.0 x 164.0 cm, about 4 cm narrower and 4 cm taller than requested. fit_glb.py exited 1, i.e. outside the repository's asset-check tolerance.

Not inspected in a render; no render was available to this agent. Geometry was checked numerically instead: a radius-by-height profile shows an 18.1 cm-radius disc base from 0-5 cm, a continuous 2.83 cm-radius stem from 5-87 cm, and a 15.0 cm-radius cylindrical shade from 87-164 cm. The slender stem is therefore neither broken nor fused to the shade or base.
PBR textures resized to 1024 px, so fine washi paper and wood-grain detail is softer than the source sheet.
